name: Belrise Industries Ltd
_note: Fact base for the Belrise Industries initiation (consolidated; Rs crore unless stated; company figures in INR million converted to crore). Only sources published on or before 30-Sep-2026. FY = year to March.

q4deck.what: Q4FY26 investor presentation: FY26 P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, segment split, new plants, Chester Hall

q4call.what: Q4FY26 call transcript (call 25-May-2026): FY27 guidance, merger, QIP enabling resolution, SDM loss

ar26.what: Annual Report FY2025-26: accounts, other-income note 28, investments note 9, remuneration (Rule 5), auditors

scheme.what: Board outcome: scheme of amalgamation of BAPL and EITSPL, swap ratios, pre/post shareholding

obsLetter.what: NSE/BSE observation letters (no adverse observations) on the scheme

qip.what: QIP allotment: 7,72,72,727 shares at Rs220 (floor Rs230.79, opened 14-Jul-2026)

hyva.what: Business transfer agreement for Hyva India's tipper-body business (USD 5.65m, ~Rs54 cr, slump sale, ~3.6x EV/EBITDA)

chester.what: Chester Hall Precision Engineering acquisition presentation

ipoTrack.what: IPO track-record disclosure (BRLM): issue Rs2,150 cr at Rs90, 43.58x subscribed, listed 28-May-2025, Rs1,596 cr of debt repaid in Q1FY26

profile.what: Auto-component maker: two-wheeler chassis systems, exhaust systems, fuel tanks, body-in-white (BIW) and other sheet-metal parts, polymer parts, mirrors, suspensions, steering columns and brakes; high-tensile chassis members for cars and trucks (H-One); tipper bodies (Hyva, from Q3FY27); small aerospace and defence units (Chester Hall UK, SDM France, Plasan Sasa alliance).
profile.facilities: 27 plants in 13 cities, 10 states, 3 countries (Q1FY27 deck); 890+ robots; 90,000+ tpa fabrication; 450+ presses up to 1,200 t
profile.customers: 38 OEMs; historically almost entirely dependent on one two-wheeler customer (MD, Q4FY26 call); name and share not disclosed in the decks we read
profile.marketShare: ~24% of Indian two-wheeler metal components (CRISIL, FY24, quoted in the decks)

guidance.revenue: Mid-teens revenue growth (FY27), 'consistent with our track record and momentum in our order book' (Q4FY26 call); repeated for Belrise as a whole in Aug-2026.
guidance.margin: EBITDA margin broadly stable vs FY26 (12.1%); Q1 cost pressures (steel, polymer, wages, energy) 'largely behind us', margins to rise in the coming quarters (Q1FY27 call).
guidance.capex: Capex 6-6.5% of manufacturing revenue, including R&D (Q4FY26 call).
guidance.fourWheelerCv: Double the 4W and CV business over two years (from FY25); FY26 4W +37%, CV +35%.
guidance.aerospace: Aerospace and defence to reach at least 10% of revenue in the medium term; SDM EBITDA positive in 2027.
guidance.qip: Rs1,700 cr raised in Jul-2026; 'significant majority' to be deployed in FY27, mainly acquisitions (aerospace globally; 4W/CV in India), EPS- and ROCE-accretive from day one.
guidance.orders: Since Apr-2026: 2W/3W OEM exhaust + fuel tank (~Rs90 cr a year) and chassis (Rs65 cr, SOP Q4FY27); 2W chassis for a top OEM's Sambhajinagar plant (~Rs50 cr); US solar-tracker assemblies (Rs150 cr+ at peak, from Q4FY27); 59 assemblies + tooling for a 4W EV; suspension/brakes for a 5th OEM (Vietnamese); 3W brake assemblies.

corporateActions: H-One India: 93.37% acquired from Japan's H-One (high-tensile steel parts for Japanese car makers); the rest later (NCI nil at Mar-2026). Mag Filters (filtration systems, plastic moulding) also acquired (date not in the sources we read).
IPO: fresh issue Rs2,150 cr at Rs90 (43.58x subscribed); Rs1,596 cr of debt repaid in Q1FY26. Shares 65.1 cr → 89.0 cr.
Promoter holding fell from 73.01% to 66.46% in the Dec-2025 quarter (shareholding pattern); share count unchanged, so a promoter sale.

Board approves merger of promoter-owned Badve Autocomps (BAPL) and Eximius Infra Tech (EITSPL): 140 Belrise shares per BAPL share, 10 per 135 EITSPL shares; 4.72 cr new shares (promoters 66.45% → 67.92%). FY25: BAPL revenue Rs1,421 cr, PAT Rs79 cr; EITSPL Rs696 cr (incl. subsidy), PAT Rs33 cr. Exchanges' no-adverse-observation letters 4-Jul-2026; NCLT approval pending on 30-Sep-2026.

Chester Hall Precision Engineering (UK aerospace machining): GBP13.2m cash/debt-free, ~6x EV/EBITDA; CY25 revenue ~GBP18.5m, EBITDA GBP2.1-2.2m. SDM (France) bought for EUR0.35m (FY27E revenue EUR3-4m); Rs9.5 cr one-time loss in Q4FY26.
QIP: 7.73 cr shares at Rs220 (Rs1,700 cr gross, Rs1,657 cr net); shares 89.0 cr → 96.7 cr; promoters 66.46% → 61.14%.
Hyva India tipper-body business: USD5.65m (~Rs54 cr), ~3.6x EV/EBITDA, three plants (Pune, Jamshedpur, Bengaluru); closing expected Q3FY27.
management: Company Secretary (from Jun-2026, after Manish Kumar resigned 7-Jun-2026)
auditors: GSA & Associates LLP (second term); Rathi Rathi & Co. proposed as joint statutory auditors; consolidated audit fees Rs1.56 cr (AR FY26)
relatedParty: Purchases from promoter-linked companies are material (several entities with Rs340-480 cr a year each in the AR FY26 related-party table); the BAPL/EITSPL merger is intended to 'materially reduce' them. Belrise holds Rs99 cr of BAPL equity and Rs4 cr of EITSPL (AR FY26 note 9).
